patch_description: The plateau at min_area_normalized ≈ 0.03 comes from two issues: (1) the softmin-free pattern search accepts moves on min-area alone, ignoring that score = min_area / hull_area, and (2) the hull denominator is never actively minimized. Key changes: (a) every accepted move in both the base refinement and the full polish is now gated on the exact true score (min_area / hull_area), with scipy's ConvexHull for fast hull-area evaluation; (b) a new hull-reduction move set — hull vertices get extra inward radial and centroid-pulling candidate directions (multiplicative contraction per hull point), letting the optimizer shrink the hull while holding min area, which directly raises the ratio; (c) periodic global contraction attempts (scale points toward centroid, repeat while the true score improves); (d) reduced seed count and a tighter polish min_step (5e-4) plus a bounded basin-hopping stage (2 elites × 3 amplitudes) to keep eval_time well under the previous 30s. All moves deterministic; seed 42 retained.
